title: Block Descriptor
description: Static definition of a block type. Consumed by the renderer (palette, Properties form) and by the Python compiler that turns block instances into CFEngine policy — see blocks/README.md for the compiler contract.

id.description: Stable identifier, stored in every instance. Custom blocks use a "custom-" prefix so they can't collide with built-ins.

version.description: This block's revision. Bump it on any change that affects stored instances or compiled output; migrations key on (id, version).

description.description: One short sentence, shown under the name and matched by palette search.

compile_target.description: own_bundle: a sequenced block — its own bundle agent, called from the file's entry bundle, with outcomes and arrows. file_vars: entries compile into the file's shared `bundle common vars` (Define Variable / Define Class) — not sequenced, no arrows.

steps.description: Ordered promises; each compiles to its own chained bundle (methods:, in order), which is how a block controls cross-promise-type ordering.

parameters.description: With steps: the block's parameters. With value_sources: those shared by every source (e.g. the variable name).

value_sources.description: Blocks whose promise varies by how the value is produced (Define Variable: literal vs command output vs file ...).

value_source_label.description: Label of the value-source selector (default "Value source").

arrow_default_outcome.description: What a newly drawn arrow from this block waits for (default "kept"). Blocks whose success is always "repaired" (commands) set that.

outcome_step.description: Index into steps whose outcome counts as the block's (for arrows), instead of the rolled-up methods: outcome. The compiler puts classes => results("namespace", ...) on that step.

entries.description: One instance holds a list of definitions (several variables/classes); each entry has its own name, value source and params.

name_param.description: The shared parameter that is each entry's defined name.

badge.description: Short hint, e.g. the function it compiles to.

group.description: Header this source is listed under in the selector.

value_type.description: vars sources: the type the source produces — what a decorator chain starts from, and the vars attribute when there's no chain (data can't be transformed).

literal.description: The value is typed in (literal, list, JSON): no data chain is drawn for it and decorators aren't offered.

promiser.description: Always a template; the compiler quotes it. An allow_list parameter here makes the promise iterate over the list.

attributes.description: CFEngine attribute -> value expression. Names the compiler sets itself (conditions, outcome classes, handles) are reserved.
